title: Return with a default
prompt: Write `scaled`, which returns value times factor, where factor has a default of 3. `scaled_twice` returns scaled(n) plus scaled(n, 1). scaled_twice(2) is 8.
hints: Called with one value the helper uses factor 3; with two it uses what you pass.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
